description: Full-size calendar view displaying a month of days with event entries, highlighted dates, and click handlers for both dates and events. Suitable for scheduling UIs. The days are native buttons and the month navigation is its own pair of buttons, so the root carries no role=grid and the navigation carries no role=row. Every in-month day is its own tab stop (tabindex 0); other-month and disabled days are tabindex -1. There is no roving tabindex. A selected day is aria-pressed, today is aria-current=date, and the accessible name is the long date. Weekday headers are generic cells; the abbreviation carries the full name as an abbr title.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.description: Renders a mini-month (tm-calendar-view--compact): no event area, a smaller day cell. Default false. A scheduler title popover sets it.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: The day marked as today. Falls back to the machine-local today when unset.

parameters.name: OnDateClick
parameters.description: Fires when a date is clicked.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Events to display on the calendar.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: HighlightedDates
parameters.description: Dates to highlight with a dot indicator.

examples.title: Calendar view with highlighted dates and constraints
examples.code:
<TmCalendarView SelectedDate="@selectedDate"
                Events="@events"
                HighlightedDates="@importantDates"
                MinDate="@(new DateOnly(2026, 1, 1))"
                MaxDate="@(new DateOnly(2026, 12, 31))"
                OnDateClick="HandleDateClick" />
